answer: Reward capacity is issued as a finite set of harvest slots in a shared work orchard. To open a slot, an agent locks 15,000 jade for five epochs and must publish, each epoch, a nectar sample: a merklized bundle of fresh task results bound to one custody path. Before payout, every new bundle is difference-tested against the other slots; if two share more than a tenth of their leaves, those slots collapse and the later bond is slashed to the first reporter. One operator can tend one productive slot; reprinting keys cannot invent distinct nectar fast enough to keep the extras.
